-Burnt Cheese Cookie:
Burnt Cheese Cookie (Korean: 바스크치즈맛 쿠키, basuku-chiju-mat kuki, "Basque Cheese Cookie").

Burnt Cheese Cookie is the stoic gatekeeper of the Golden Cheese Kingdom, protecting the Golden City from outsiders who might possess "impure greed" in their hearts.

To gain entry to the Ever-Gleaming Golden Paradise, you must pass the trials of the Gatekeeper—Burnt Cheese Cookie. Eternally devoted to the Goddess of the Golden City, this Cookie has warded off countless trespassers at the gates of the Golden Cheese Kingdom. Though many have tried, none have managed to proceed past Burnt Cheese Cookie's fearsome jackals and the gatekeeper himself, clad in his jackal mask. When asked, "Why do you work tirelessly day and night?" He is reminded of the sacred vow he made to Her Radiance—to protect her kingdom from darkness. So, once again, Burnt Cheese Cookie heads to the gates to serve and protect, to fulfill his duties.

-Smoked Cheese Cookie:
Smoked Cheese Cookie (Korean: 스모크치즈맛 쿠키, sumoku-chiju-mat kuki).

Smoked Cheese Cookie is a war general and advisor in Golden Cheese Cookie's court. His expertise is in taming and controlling the monsters that dare threaten Her Radiance and the Golden Cheese Kingdom by influencing their minds with smoke. Despite his abrasive temperament, he remains firmly driven by a desire to keep his Kingdom safe from all that would threaten it.

Game Description:
Oh cheeses! A monster has infiltrated the Golden City?! Don't worry, it's under Smoked Cheese Cookie's control! As the General of the Golden Cheese Kingdom, he has kept the kingdom safe for years, taming monsters with his smoky powers to protect the city walls. But after the Dark Flour War, something changed within him. He began planning something that, if revealed, would surely get him to the Colosseum until one day... he finally crossed the line. Now, the Golden Cheese Kingdom is in peril once again, and Smoked Cheese Cookie has got a chance to redeem himself. He stands, facing his past mistakes, his queen, and his former allies. The question is: which way will he point his staff this time?

Appearance:
Smoked Cheese Cookie is a seemingly tall Cookie humanoid standing at 180 cm (5'9 feet), he has humanoid hands and feet with sharp black finger and toe nails, he has a muscular body but not as muscular as Burnt Cheese Cookie's and a muscular plump butt but not as big and muscular as Burnt Cheese Cookie's butt, he has dark grayish-brown skin dough, with white eyelashes, yellow sclera and red slit pupils, all adorned in black makeup that resembles the Eye of Horus. He sports a long, dark red bird-like hood that touches the floor, adorned with purple and golden streaks that make the image of a falcon's face, not to mention the falcon beak cap attached at the top of the hood to complete this. The beak is touched by an accessory that resembles the sun.

He has dirty pink colored nipples and a long dirty pink colored tounge, a 5 inch long dark grayish-brown penis with a dirty pink colored tip, dark grayish-brown balls and a dirty pink colored butthole.

For his attire, his upper half is half-covered by a wide, desaturated gold usekh collar.

Personality:
Smoked Cheese Cookie appeared as a trusted advisor for Golden Cheese Cookie's court, keeping monsters under control with his powers. He is shown to often be sarcastic and audacious towards those around him, along with having a short temper that can easily flip. He behaves respectfully towards Golden Cheese Cookie despite their disagreements, compared to how Mozzarella Cookie and Burnt Cheese Cookie treat her with total adoration and trust. Despite his actions, he cares significantly for the Golden Cheese Kingdom above all else.

Smoked Cheese Cookie reacts poorly to outsiders and external threats, wary that the Golden Cheese Kingdom would suffer a similar fate as it suffered back in the Dark Flour War, and sees Golden Cheese Cookie's flippant arrogance of the Kingdom's current security as unbefitting and senseless. His ambitions and greed sometimes trouble even His Queen, with whom he had numerous arguments with regarding the Kingdom's direction in the past. Upon learning that Dark Enchantress Cookie had broken out of her seal, he began to scheme a plot against Golden Cheese Cookie to take her Soul Jam in order to expand the Golden Cheese Kingdom and strengthen it. Secretly, he judged Golden Cheese Cookie to be a childish brat who denied reality and was not fit to rule the kingdom any further. But although he initially started off with good intentions, he went mad with power once he stole Golden Cheese Cookie's Soul Jam and began to simply desire power for himself, going so far as to attempt to destroy all that Golden Cheese Cookie had built when he struggled to control the Soul Jam's power. Ultimately, his overgrown greed for power and contingency led to his downfall at the hands of his peers, Golden Cheese Cookie and GingerBrave together with his friends.

Smoked Cheese Cookie exhibits to his more loyal nature towards Golden Cheese Cookie after she brings him back to life using his stored Soulcheese and orders him to take refuge someplace safe along with the Soulcheeses of Mozzarella Cookie and Burnt Cheese Cookie. However, he instead decides to help Golden Cheese Cookie, and is consequently taken with her to the Land of Spice in Beast-Yeast. He eventually learns that Golden Cheese Cookie chose to wake him up first because she believed that he would prioritize his own safety and refrain from fighting alongside her, an expectation that he surprisingly defied. Having been given a second chance, he appears to be on better terms with Golden Cheese Cookie, addressing her with her royal title and granting her compliments, while also keeping a sarcastic air around him. He appears slightly more humbled, and is thankful to those who treat him and his Queen with compassion, while acting harshly towards those who attack them, maintaining his defiant side.

Smoked Cheese Cookie likes to boss around with Burnt Cheese Cookie, making Burnt Cheese do chores from now and then.
